node.label: Abnormal cutaneous elastic fiber morphology
node.definition: Any structural anomaly of the elastic fibers of the skin. Elastic fibers are the essential extracellular matrix macromolecules comprising an elastin core surrounded by a mantle of fibrillin-rich microfibrils.

evidence.snippet: Autosomal recessive cutis laxa type 2A: Abnormal cutaneous elastic fiber morphology (frequency HP:0040281) [TAS]
Abnormal cutaneous elastic fiber morphology — Very frequent (99-80%)
